level_definitions.V0: not constituted: no stable semantic/test object yet
level_definitions.V1: represented/constituted: object or semantic contract exists
level_definitions.V2: operationally realizable: a non-oracular executable/native path can attempt the object
level_definitions.V3: demonstrated: the target function/property itself has a bounded witness under frozen conditions
level_definitions.V4: demonstrated under changed conditions: the same target survives a genuinely changed/held-out condition; seed-only replay does not qualify

coding_rules: One representative load-bearing transformation is coded per repository in repository_inventory; mature_assay_atlas adds multiple important assays for later repositories.
A negative execution does not earn V3 for the desired function: it remains V2 with V3=FAIL/NOT_EVALUABLE.
V4 requires a genuinely changed or held-out condition for the same function; seed-only replay is not sufficient.
OPEN/NOT_RUN is not coded as FAIL.
No row promotes a source repository beyond its frozen claim ceiling.
